claims.assertion: Swaruu says Earth reincarnation can become a trap imposed by religions and an alleged Van Allen etheric barrier; she claims sufficiently high frequency may escape it.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes reincarnation spirals linking people who believe they owe one another karmic debts, sometimes as the same soul across lives.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu says reincarnation spirals accumulate experience and expand, so lives never repeat exactly.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She advises taking lessons from experiences, forgiving oneself, and letting go of karmic burdens to ascend.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
